surface_name: Supabase Auth signup with a trigger on auth.users
title: Supabase signUp fails with Database error saving new user after adding a profiles trigger
symptoms: AuthApiError: Database error saving new user (500, unexpected_failure)
Inviting a user from the dashboard fails with the same message
Signups worked until a trigger on auth.users was added
cause: A trigger on auth.users runs inside the signup transaction, so any error in it (missing column, NOT NULL, wrong search_path, missing grant) rolls back the whole signup. The Auth role does not see unqualified public tables unless the function is security definer with a fixed search_path.
fix: Declare the function security definer with search_path set to empty, fully qualify every table, make inserted columns nullable or defaulted, and read the real error in the Auth and Postgres logs.
affected: Supabase Auth on hosted and self-hosted projects with triggers or constraints on auth.users
